questions.q: What underlying technology does Oracle Fusion Expenses use to configure approval routing?
options: Approval Management Extensions (AMX), part of the same SOA/BPM suite used elsewhere in Fusion
A single hardcoded field pointing to the employee's manager
A spreadsheet maintained manually by HR
There is no configurable routing; approval is random
questions.explain: Expense approval routing is built on AMX/BPM, the same flexible rule-engine technology used for other Fusion approval workflows like Payables invoices.

questions.q: Which predefined rule set routes an approval to the owner(s) of the cost center(s) a report will post to?
options: ExpenseReportRuleSet
ProjectManagerRuleSet
CostCenterRuleSet
ExpenseRuleSet
questions.explain: CostCenterRuleSet routes approval to the cost center owner(s), running in parallel if the report spans multiple cost centers.

questions.q: Can more than one approval rule set apply to the same expense report at the same time?
options: No, only one rule set can ever be active company-wide
Only if the report has zero expense items
Only on reports under $10
Yes, multiple rule sets can run in parallel, such as supervisor approval plus cost center owner approval
questions.explain: Castellan's own setup combines ExpenseReportRuleSet and CostCenterRuleSet in parallel for reports that cross cost centers.

questions.q: Where does an approver typically see and act on an expense report approval request?
options: Only by physically visiting the Payables department
In the Oracle BPM Worklist, often also delivered by email
It is never visible to the approver in any system
Only in the General Ledger journal entry screen
questions.explain: Approval requests appear as tasks in the Oracle BPM Worklist and, depending on setup, also arrive by email.

questions.q: What prevents an expense report from stalling indefinitely if an approver never acts on it?
options: The report is automatically deleted after one day
Nothing; the report waits forever
An escalation rule that forwards the request to the approver's own manager after a set number of days
The employee's salary is automatically reduced
questions.explain: Escalation settings, part of the approval rule configuration, forward an unacted-on request to the approver's manager after a configured period.
